chat.cataclysm_primed_soul.ignis_prime.a: The excitement around me is building...
chat.cataclysm_primed_soul.ignis_prime.h: The heat transforms into unrelenting pressure, and the equipment begins to melt.
chat.cataclysm_primed_soul.ignis_prime.p: A pure white soul fills my vision. All protection has turned to ash...
tooltip.cataclysm_primed_soul.abyssal_as: §6 If you offer it to the Altar of Fire again, something might happen.
item.cataclysm_primed_soul.lavatein.desc: A sword that gains speed with every strike, its outer layer peeling away.
Applies debuffs to the target based on the three stages of release.
